User: Tomorrow at six AM. 
Agent: Tomorrow at six AM, noted. What airline and flight number are you on?
User: United one two three four at eight fifteen. 
Agent: We'll be tracking your flight. How many passengers, and how many bags?

User: John Smith, 
Agent: Thanks, John. Is the number you're calling from, four one four - five five five - zero one zero zero, the best one to reach you?
User: That number is fine. 
Agent: Okay to text the trip sheet to that number?
User: Yes. 
Agent: United one two three four at eight fifteen into O'Hare International landing Friday October thirtieth at 6 AM Central, 2 passengers, 3 bags, written for an Executive SUV. We'll be tracking your flight.
